## Problem
What's missing or frustrating? What are you trying to do?

## Proposed Solution
How do YOU think it should work? Be as specific as you can. _Think: How will this improvement benefit others?_

## Alternatives Considered
Have you tried any workarounds or considered other approaches?

## Additional Context
Mockups, screenshots, links to similar features in other apps, etc.
